title: Make world_query discovery return module canon records
description:
Problem

The post-p4vd playtest showed that world_query discovery is too brittle for module canon. The model repeatedly tried queries such as:

  {"type":"npc","query":"Warden Sela"}

and received not_found. Exact-id lookup such as:

  {"type":"npc","id":"warden-sela"}

can work, but the DM cannot reliably know exact module IDs during play. Search-style queries also tended to surface overlay lore more reliably than module NPCs, locations, or lore.

This causes ordinary follow-up dialogue to fail mechanics/world audit even when the target is authored module canon.

Acceptance criteria

- world_query search for "Warden Sela" returns the module NPC.
- world_query search for "authority figure Emberfall" returns Warden Sela or enough metadata to query her exact ID.
- search for "watchtower", "north road", "hollow", "Emberfall incident", and similar terms returns relevant module locations/lore plus overlay lore where applicable.
- Module canon search results include enough metadata for safe follow-up:
  - canon tier/source
  - entity type
  - entity id
  - summary/name
  - visibility where applicable
- Overlay lore and module canon both participate in discovery; one does not crowd out the other.
- Type-specific query misuse is handled gracefully:
  - either {"type":"npc","query":"Warden Sela"} performs a constrained NPC search
  - or it fails with actionable guidance telling the DM to use type:"search" or an exact id
- Add regression tests from the Emberfall playtest pattern:
  - find Warden Sela by name
  - find Warden Sela by "authority figure"
  - find the watchtower/hollow by natural subject terms
  - retrieve both module canon and overlay lore for a location-oriented query
close_reason: Implemented constrained typed world_query discovery and tokenized module search with Emberfall regressions.
